g.text: Design notes

g.desc: Design notes

g.text: 1. ADC A: PT100 3-wire, IDAC 2 x 500 uA, RREF 1.69 k (VREF 1.69 V), gain 16, 20 SPS. Swap IDAC1/IDAC2

g.desc: 1. ADC A: PT100 3-wire, IDAC 2 x 500 uA, RREF 1.69 k (VREF 1.69 V), gain 16, 20 SPS. Swap IDAC1/IDAC2

g.text: (I1MUX/I2MUX) on alternate conversions and average: removes IDAC mismatch to first order.

g.desc: (I1MUX/I2MUX) on alternate conversions and average: removes IDAC mismatch to first order.

g.text: 2. ADC B bridge: AIN0-AIN1, gain 128, VREF[1:0] = 11 (AVDD - AVSS) - ratiometric to the excitation.

g.desc: 2. ADC B bridge: AIN0-AIN1, gain 128, VREF[1:0] = 11 (AVDD - AVSS) - ratiometric to the excitation.

g.text: 3. ADC B +/-10 V: AIN2-AIN3, PGA bypassed, gain 1, VREF = REF5025 on REFP0.

g.desc: 3. ADC B +/-10 V: AIN2-AIN3, PGA bypassed, gain 1, VREF = REF5025 on REFP0.

g.text: V(AIN2) - V(AIN3) = 0.1243 x VIN; linear range -13.7 V ... +14.0 V (calc/analog_calc.md).

g.desc: V(AIN2) - V(AIN3) = 0.1243 x VIN; linear range -13.7 V ... +14.0 V (calc/analog_calc.md).

g.text: 4. One GND (In1 solid plane). Digital lines stay in the strip next to J1.

g.desc: 4. One GND (In1 solid plane). Digital lines stay in the strip next to J1.

g.text: 5. R8/R10/R13 are 0 ohm links that fix the copper topology (Kelvin RREF, EXC+ feed point).
